resolution: Solidified the hollow trunk + gave palms collision (dbac45e3f). HOLLOW: the trunk read as a 'C' because its winding (mirrored from PalmTrunk.ts) culled the OUTER wall under cull_mode=.back/front_face=.ccw, so you saw through to the back wall; flipped to CCW-outward in BOTH buildPalmTrunk and PalmTrunk.ts (the probe never caught it, never viewing a trunk up close). COLLISION: a per-trunk AABB in buildPhysicsColliders' baked-collider path (the path real maps take), keyed on SHAPE_PALMTRUNK so grass/bush/frond cards stay collisionless — verified physics rects rise one-per-trunk. NOTE: couldn't frame it in the headless proof camera (only frames spawn); user verifies solid+walk-blocking in-game after recompile.
